name: EPIC 210393467

text.card: A red giant 1,603 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.02 solar masses and 8.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,669 K at its surface.
